deadline.value: Completed applications are due January 5 (students start in September).
deadline.quote: Students are admitted only in September. Completed applications should be received by January 5.

app_fee.quote: There is a $70 non-refundable application fee (those in need can request an application fee waiver within the application).

fee_waiver.value: Applicants in need can request a waiver within the application.
fee_waiver.quote: There is a $70 non-refundable application fee (those in need can request an application fee waiver within the application).

gre_subject.value: GRE Math Subject scores are strongly encouraged but not required.
gre_subject.quote: Applicants are strongly encouraged to submit GRE Math Subject exam scores.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 with at least 21 in speaking.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL scores required are: 100 (IBT) with minimum of 21 on speaking portion

supervisor.value: The admissions page does not say whether a supervisor is needed before admission.

funding.value: Students in good standing are supported for at least four years; most entering students get a teaching assistantship with full tuition waiver and a stipend.
funding.quote: Graduate students in good standing are supported for at least four years. | Most entering students are appointed teaching assistantships, which includes a full tuition waiver and a stipend of $26,000, depending on teaching duties.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's is needed.

notes: The page still contains an old line 'The deadline for fall 2026 admission is January 5, 2026', so the January 5 date for 2027 is inferred from the undated line. Incoming foreign students may first be graders until their spoken English is evaluated.
